name: worktree-batch
description: Git worktrees as disposable workspaces, plus batches of unattended jobs that accumulate on one branch. /mkwt creates a worktree and moves the session into it, /wtmerge and /fwtmerge land its work on the base branch, /projectreview turns a commit review into ready-to-open worktree jobs, /sequencework runs an approved queue of jobs in sequence onto a single pending branch and is resumable after a kill.
